required_cases.given: a draft RuntimeRevision without any Route or ExecutionBinding
required_cases.when: the Publication runner probes the candidate RuntimeAdapter
expect: probeCapabilities returns a structurally valid capability manifest
protocol_versions and feature booleans and numeric limits are present
no platform object (Route, Binding, Invocation, Event, Tool, Memory, Child Thread) is required

required_cases.given: a draft RuntimeRevision and no business Invocation
required_cases.when: startInvocation is invoked exactly once on the candidate adapter
expect: startInvocation is invoked exactly once (no duplicate dispatch calls)
the adapter returns accepted=true
runtime_execution_ref and runtime_session_ref are unique and non-empty
the returned capabilities exactly match the suite's single probe snapshot
the acknowledgement is produced by the real adapter, not fabricated

required_cases.given: a candidate RuntimeRevision advertised as cancellable
required_cases.when: handleCancel is invoked on the candidate adapter
expect: the adapter returns cancel_state=accepted (a real acknowledgement)
already_completed_effects_preserved is a boolean
cancel is a base publication capability and must actually ack

required_cases.given: the adapter capability manifest advertises a steer feature
expect: if features.steer is true, handleSteer returns accepted at next_safe_point
if features.steer is false, the runner only verifies steer is not advertised
no steer command is fabricated when the capability is absent

required_cases.given: the adapter capability manifest advertises a resume feature
expect: if features.resume is true, handleResume returns accepted
if features.resume is false, the runner only verifies resume is not advertised
no resume command is fabricated when the capability is absent

required_cases.given: a candidate RuntimeRevision resumes a session
required_cases.when: the Publication runner verifies session recovery declaration
expect: if features.filesystem_checkpoint is false, the adapter proves it does not advertise filesystem-level recovery
if features.filesystem_checkpoint is true, the adapter must also advertise features.resume=true
when filesystem_checkpoint=true, the runner performs a real resume probe carrying a checkpointRef
when filesystem_checkpoint=true, handleResume must return requires_redispatch=false (no redispatch needed)
otherwise the case is fail-closed (the adapter does not claim filesystem-level recovery it cannot provide)
